conceptName: Run a sync and read the console

items.stem: A run is scheduled via Windows Task Scheduler. How do you see its live console output?

options.text: Open the scheduled task's log tab — it captures the console
Re-run the Run's .cmd manually from a command prompt
You can't — runs never produce console output
Read it from the EntityValueChange table

items.explanation: Scheduled runs have no visible console; re-running the .cmd manually shows live per-segment progress.

misconceptions.d: EntityValueChange holds field diffs after the fact, not live console output.

items.stem: A segment finishes with almost all 'No changes detected' and 'Exception thrown: 0'. What does that indicate?

options.text: A healthy no-op run — the source matched what was already synced
A failed run that synced nothing

items.explanation: Mostly NoChangesDetected with no exceptions means the snapshot matched last run's state — nothing to do, which is healthy.

misconceptions.c: An initial load shows a wave of New entity created, not No changes detected.

items.stem: A segment reports 'Rejected: 8'. Is that an error to fix?

options.text: Yes — every rejection is a failure that must be corrected
No — Rejected means 'can't be processed yet' (e.g. a dependency not migrated this pass), not an error
No — Rejected means the records were deleted
Yes — it means the destination is down

items.explanation: Rejected is a preprocessor 'try again later' outcome (often a parent not yet present); it isn't an error by itself. ExceptionThrown is the one to chase.

misconceptions.a: Rejections are expected during ordered migrations; they often clear on a later pass.

items.stem: A run's Section segment ends with 'New entity created: 0' and 'Exception thrown: 47'. What do you conclude, and what's your next step?
rubric: 47 exceptions is a real problem that needs follow-up (unlike Rejected)
Next step is to get the exception detail/text — query StarBridge (EntityTransaction Outcome=11) and the Operation/Message text, or use the diagnostic scripts
Identify the affected entity/segment (Section) to scope the fix
items.sampleAnswer: 47 ExceptionThrown means 47 records errored — that needs investigation. The console only gives the count, so I'd go to StarBridge: EntityTransaction filtered to Outcome = 11 for which Section records threw, and the Operation/Message rows (or the ExceptionRejections script) for the actual error text, then trace the root cause.

items.stem: Why is there no console to read from the scheduled run, and how do you get one?
rubric: Runs are launched by Windows Task Scheduler, which doesn't surface the console
Re-run the same command / .cmd manually from a command prompt to watch live progress
items.sampleAnswer: The scheduler runs the command headless, so there's no console to watch. To see live progress you re-run the Run's .cmd yourself from a command prompt.
